features.text: COMPREHENSIVE LIGAMENT PROTECTION: Supports ACL, PCL, and collateral ligaments for recovery and prevention.

PIVOT POINT STRAP SYSTEM: Prevents brace shifting and maintains consistent alignment.
ANATOMICAL WOMEN’S FIT: Designed to match female leg contours for optimal performance.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
